quest.title: A Letter
quest.description: You meet Iaune again at the Fontaine Research Institute...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Mora x30000, Hero's Wit x3

talks.objective: Go to the Fontaine Research Institute

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: ...Just like I stressed before, dear Gestionnaire, that's how the procedure goes and there's nothing I can do.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte did send the list of required documents and I do have them ready.

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: However, you can't simply come over and take any document. That does not conform with our letter delivery regulations.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hi, Iaune. You're looking good!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: You as well. It's all thanks to the help I've received from Mr. Roialte and Mr. Semaine.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #You know {NICKNAME} too, Iaune?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #Of course. {NICKNAME} did me a huge favor before. Without {M#him}{F#her}, I wouldn't still be working at the Maison Gestion.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #Really? No wonder {NICKNAME} is an Honorary Senior Researcher of the Institute, hahahaha!

choices.text: I'm very good at providing moral support.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Regardless, without your support, I'm sure... I couldn't have made it...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I believe I heard Mr. Choiseul call you an Honorary Senior Researcher of the Institute just now?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Bingo. I even have the certificate.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: And a photo! Paimon's in it, too, but Paimon didn't get a certificate...

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #Yes, in recognition of {NICKNAME}'s merits and achievements, the Institute has granted {M#him}{F#her} the title of Honorary Senior Researcher.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #As for what those "achievements" are... I'll let {M#him}{F#her} speak for {M#himself}{F#herself}. Let's talk business first.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: I really cannot hand that document to you right now, Iaune.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: But as for what you asked earlier that you'd like a researcher to guide you over and take some pictures near the Institute... That's no problem at all!

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #I think {NICKNAME} might just be suited to the job. {M#He}{F#She} knows the surroundings like the back of {M#his}{F#her} hand, and shall be more than equal to the task.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: #What do you say, {M#Mr.}{F#Ms.} {NICKNAME}?

choices.text: No problem. Leave it to me.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: You're so kind. As long as you're there, it should be fine. When I came, all I saw were out-of-control meka and monsters...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But taking pictures isn't the priority here. Truth be told, Mr. Choiseul...

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: I'd love to help you too, Iaune, but the procedure is procedure and my hands are tied. Please don't make it hard on a lowly public official who only knows how to stamp documents.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: All right, I'll discuss this with Mr. Roialte later, after I return...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Goodbye, Mr. Choiseul. Have a nice day.

response.speaker: Choiseul
response.text: Thank you. I hope you enjoy your time at the Fontaine Research Institute.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #It's your turn to be the guide now, {NICKNAME}. Why don't we go to the Mary-Ann Memorial Park first?

choices.text: I'm happy to help Iaune out.
All I did was fix the Autostamper 3000.
Then I'll fly over here with you later.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #{NICKNAME}! So glad to see you. What luck!

talks.objective: Go to the Mary-Ann Memorial Park
Defeat all of the malfunctioning meka

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Uh, is this the Mary-Ann Memorial Park? I can't tell it's a park at all...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte will be disappointed. He was hoping to have someone make a speech here.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Looking around, a speech is out of the question. There's not even an iconic landmark here, and it's not good for group photos.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You can take some meka back with you as a memento.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: You're funny, but there's no room in the Maison Gestion for such things.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: And even if I could, I'd still have to have the meka appraised, reported, categorized, then stored...

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Hey! We're only joking. No need to get so focused on work all of a sudden...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Speaking of reports... I still can't get that document. Mr. Roialte will be disappointed again...

choices.text: Is Choiseul making it difficult for you?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Not exactly. My request was not quite by-the-book, so it's no surprise that he rejected it.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: As you may know, the Institute is making plans to rebuild, right? Certain resources and personnel arrangements have to be made through the Maison Gestion.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: The Maison Gestion takes this matter very seriously, so it had Mr. Roialte select a team to conduct field studies in and around the vicinity.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Therefore, Mr. Roialte stayed behind at the Maison Gestion to do the head count, while I am to visit the Institute to coordinate the reception.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: It happens that the Institute has a letter for the Maison Gestion, so I thought since I'm here already, I might as well bring it back with me...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: But Mr. Choiseul insisted it was a violation of proper procedure and simply would not give it to me.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Violation of procedure? What procedure?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are proper procedures for picking up a document?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Uh, don't tell Paimon there's gonna be running around for approvals, signatures, and listening to bureaucrats babble on endlessly as well...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Simply put, most official correspondence within the Maison Gestion must be mailed.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Then... What if the departments mailing the letter are on the same street, or even right across from each other?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Yes, you still have to mail it. That's for the purpose of being "traceable."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Gestionnaires sure aren't afraid of work.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I suppose everyone is just used to it all by now...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Never mind, let's just go to the next spot. Let me check the memo Mr. Roialte left for me... Uh...

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: This place is called... the Institute's Academic Assembly Hall. Strange... I didn't see any buildings with such a sign when I came.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I know where it is, just follow me.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I knew I could depend on you! What would I do without you?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Let's hurry, then. There might be more out-of-control meka around here...

choices.text: What were you and Choiseul discussing back there?

talks.objective: Go to the Academic Assembly Hall

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Is this the Academic Assembly Hall?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I admit, the structure does look like a hall, but what's academic about it?

choices.text: The academic part is in the researchers' heads.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: All right, good thing I didn't come for anything academic today. Anyway, the building seems relatively... intact.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Intact is all it has left.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Ahem! Come on, let's look around. I think this place is perfect for a group photo.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: I should go find a good vantage point so I won't be at a complete loss if Mr. Roialte grills me.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #Please take a few pictures for me too, {NICKNAME}. I heard you're a good photographer, certainly better than me!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I got this.

choices.text: The rocks aren't academic, that's for sure.

talks.objective: Take pictures around the perimeter and give them to Iaune
Take pictures around the perimeter and give them to Iaune

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: This one isn't bad... Have you finished taking pictures yet?

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: Once you're done, please show them to me.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Oh my... Too high, far too high!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you describing the Institute's academic level?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: No, I'm marveling at the height of this place! Though the Institute's academics were certainly up there too...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: But now... *sigh* Who could've foreseen so many hardships for the Institute? And who knows how smooth the reconstruction will be...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: The last stop is... The Fontaine Research Institute Qualifications Review Representative Office.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: All in one breath, impressive.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Thank you. But where is it? I didn't notice any such office in the Institute.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Is Desnos in charge of the office?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Yes! That's right! You know even this place? I shouldn't be surprised that the Honorary Senior Researcher knows everything about the Institute!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Oh, Paimon remembers now! Is it that office in the ruins? If you can count that as an office...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Maybe Mr. Desnos shortened the name to make it easy for you to understand.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Please lead the way. I have to get some files from Mr. Desnos too. Once I have them, I can return to the Maison Gestion.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: It's been such an uneventful day today. I should be able to go back and relax soon. The Fontaine Research Institute sure does things differently from... Ahem, I didn't say a thing.

talks.objective: Go to the Qualifications Review Representative Office

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: O Archons save me, may no more meka cause trouble... What are you doing here, Iaune?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Mr. Roialte has sent me here to conduct an inspection, so I thought I'd drop by and bring you some coffee.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: But I have to say that your working environment is indeed... quite difficult. I thought this "office" would at least have an actual room.

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Thank you for the coffee, my dear Iaune. As for the work environment... I'm content with what I have. Look around, at least I'm working under an intact ceiling.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Are you still in charge of the qualifications review?

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: #{NICKNAME}! No... I should call you Honorary Senior Researcher! Glad to see you.

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: And what's with that sad look, Iaune?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh*... It's like this...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: With a long face, Iaune recounts all that has happened...

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Hmm... Is the correspondence some sort of classified document?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: It can't be. Replies like this are typically in the vein of "Got it," "I have no questions," "I don't know," or something similar...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: At most, it's copied to different departments to let them know it's something they should care about.

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Oh, no wonder I got a copy of the letter too... Have a look, is this it?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: What!? But Mr. Choiseul clearly said he hadn't mailed it yet!

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: ...Oh, he must've meant that the external letters haven't been sent out yet.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Once more, he failed to tell the whole story.

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: People from the Institute are really good at getting under your skin, huh...

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Judging from your reaction, this must be the document you wanted. I've read it several times already, myself.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: This is identical to the document you wanted.

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: #Very astute, {NICKNAME}. I'm sure all the letters that Choiseul sent out are the same, Iaune.

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Why don't you just take my copy back with you?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Wait, what? If Iaune takes it, then won't you have lost yours?

dialogues.speaker: Desnos
dialogues.text: Hahahaha, look at me! Nobody will care if someone in my position accidentally loses a nonessential letter.

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: See, Iaune, I'm not just mooching coffee off you!

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: No, Monsieur, I cannot do that. It's against regulations. I'll go back and wait for the official letter to be delivered.

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: My dear Iaune, think outside the box, don't be a fool! Why must you insist on making it hard for yourself?

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: Who knows when that letter will get to you! The sooner you get it, the sooner you can start working and settle all that mess.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: No, Monsieur. Thank you, but I will not violate regulations. My duty as a civil servant demands it.

response.speaker: Iaune
response.text: #{NICKNAME}, Mr. Desnos, and Paimon, I must leave now. Mr. Roialte is still waiting for me to report back.

response.speaker: Black Screen
response.text: Iaune walks away with solemn, heavy steps...

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: *sigh* Iaune can be such a fool. His brains have gone all rotten, haven't they?

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: Everyone else tries to make things easier for themselves, yet he insists on going through the motions, even for small things like this.

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: Admirable, yet scary at the same time. No wonder he has few friends in the Maison Gestion other than Roialte and Semaine.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: I'm his friend too.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: So is Paimon, so is Paimon!

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: That's good. You should be around him more often. I feel Iaune's nerves are getting more and more frayed by the day...

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: As for the letter, I'll see what I can do. I'll pay Mr. Choiseul a visit and ask him to let me mail them out.

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: If he agrees, I'll send one to Iaune as quickly as possible.

response.speaker: Desnos
response.text: *sigh* It takes a lot of effort to be friends with a fool...

choices.text: That's just the person Iaune is.
That does solve the problem, doesn't it?

dialogues.speaker: Choiseul
dialogues.text: Raimondo still isn't back yet... What is he up to?

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: Those meka look like they are out of control. I noticed as soon as I arrived.

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: I even took the long route just to bypass them...

dialogues.speaker: Iaune
dialogues.text: *sigh* The Fontaine Research Institute is just letting them run wild here, and doing nothing about them...
